description: The bar chart illustrates performance gain (in percent) for three LVLMs under two training/supervision settings, comparing “Strong Supervision” versus “Weak Supervision.” The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled (left to right) GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, and the vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. For each model, two adjacent bars are shown: a hatched medium-blue bar for Strong Supervision and a solid light-blue bar for Weak Supervision, with no stacking. GPT-4o shows a Strong Supervision bar at approximately 24–25% and a Weak Supervision bar at about 5%. Claude-3.5-Sonnet shows a Strong Supervision bar near 9–10% and a Weak Supervision bar around 3–4%. Qwen2-72B-VL shows a Strong Supervision bar at roughly 15% and a Weak Supervision bar at about 5%. The categories appear in a fixed model-name order (not visibly sorted by bar height), and no individual bars are specially annotated beyond the legend and the hatch pattern used to emphasize the Strong Supervision series.
